Warn.SelectToken: Select one of your tokens first.

Hud.ExtraAction: {name} gains an additional action from Action Surge.

Mount.Label: Mount
Mount.NotOwner: You don't own this mount – the GM has to grant you ownership so you can use its actions.

Sets.Tip: Weapon sets – drag a weapon from the sheet onto a slot, right-click clears it
Sets.EmptySlot: No weapon set assigned – drag a weapon from your character sheet here.
Sets.OwnItemsOnly: Only this character's items can go into a weapon set.

dash.Name: Dash
dash.Desc: You gain extra movement equal to your speed for this turn.

disengage.Name: Disengage
disengage.Desc: Your movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks for the rest of the turn.

dodge.Name: Dodge
dodge.Desc: Until your next turn, attacks against you have disadvantage and you have advantage on Dexterity saving throws.

help.Name: Help
help.Desc: You help an ally with a check or distract an enemy so an ally's next attack has advantage.

ready.Name: Ready
ready.Desc: You choose a trigger and prepare an action to take as a reaction.

search.Name: Search
search.Desc: You look for something (Wisdom check, e.g. Perception).

study.Name: Study
study.Desc: You examine something closely (Intelligence check, e.g. Investigation).

influence.Name: Influence
influence.Desc: You try to persuade, intimidate or deceive a creature (Charisma or Wisdom check).

utilize.Name: Utilize
utilize.Desc: You use a nonmagical object or interact with an object.

theme.Name: Theme
theme.Hint: Look of the combat HUD. Other modules (e.g. the Themer) can add more themes.

scale.Name: Size
scale.Hint: Base size of the HUD (1 = normal).

left.Name: Edge offset (px)
left.Hint: Distance from the left edge (or from the right edge next to the sidebar when the portrait is on the right).

bottom.Name: Bottom offset (px)
bottom.Hint: Distance from the bottom screen edge.

openOnSelect.Name: Open on select
openOnSelect.Hint: Opens the HUD whenever you select one of your tokens.

openOnCombat.Name: Open in combat
openOnCombat.Hint: Opens the HUD when combat starts and on your character's turn.

hideFoundryUi.Name: Hide hotbar and player list
hideFoundryUi.Hint: Hides the Foundry hotbar and player list while the HUD is open.

rangeRing.Name: Show range
rangeRing.Hint: Shows an action's range as a ring around the token when hovering it.

limitedFeaturesInBar.Name: Show limited-use features directly
limitedFeaturesInBar.Hint: Features with limited uses appear as small tiles directly in the panel instead of inside the folder.

showEmptyPanels.Name: Show empty panels
showEmptyPanels.Hint: Shows Bonus Action, Reaction and Special even when they are empty.

hideUnprepared.Name: Prepared spells only
hideUnprepared.Hint: Unprepared spells are hidden in the HUD (cantrips, at-will and innate spells stay).

switchEquip.Name: Equip weapon sets
switchEquip.Hint: Switching weapon sets equips/unequips the weapons automatically.

trackMovement.Name: Track movement in combat
trackMovement.Hint: Shows remaining movement for the current turn in combat.

trackEconomy.Name: Mark actions as used
trackEconomy.Hint: After use, Action/Bonus/Reaction/Mount is greyed out until your next turn.

autoScale.Name: Auto scale
autoScale.Hint: Adapts the size to the screen width and shrinks the HUD if it doesn't fit. The size below applies on top.

portraitRight.Name: Portrait on the right (mirrored)
portraitRight.Hint: Places the HUD on the right edge: portrait on the right, all panels in mirrored order.

freePosition.Name: Free positioning
freePosition.Hint: Shows a handle to drag the HUD anywhere. The position is saved. Turning it off snaps it back to the edge.

fadeOutInactive.Name: Fade out when idle
fadeOutInactive.Hint: The HUD turns transparent while the mouse isn't over it.

fadeoutOpacity.Name: Faded opacity
fadeoutOpacity.Hint: How visible the HUD stays while faded.

showBasicActions.Name: Show basic actions
showBasicActions.Hint: Shows the folder with Dash, Disengage, Dodge etc. in the Action panel.

condenseFeatures.Name: Stack features in pairs
condenseFeatures.Hint: Limited-use features are shown as two half tiles to save space.

macroPanel.Name: Macro panel
macroPanel.Hint: Shows the macros of the first hotbar page as a panel in the HUD.

explodeActivities.Name: Show activities separately
explodeActivities.Hint: If an item has several activities (e.g. attack and damage), they can appear as separate tiles. With 'Never' there is one tile and Foundry asks which activity on click.

mountPanel.Name: Show mount panel
mountPanel.Hint: While riding (Ascandir - DnD5e Mounting), shows the 'Mount' panel with the mount's actions.

showResources.Name: Show resources
showResources.Hint: Vertical strip next to the portrait with spell slots and the character's resource pools (ki/focus, Channel Divinity, sorcery points, superiority dice, psionic energy) – only what the character has.

showOtherAbilities.Name: Show other abilities
showOtherAbilities.Hint: Abilities without a fixed activation (e.g. Sneak Attack, Divine Strike, Metamagic, Arcane Recovery) appear in the Special panel under 'Other Abilities'.
